trailhead.label: the tourist office in the centre of Virgen, the board’s start

cautions: Wooden bridges and a short flight of steps.
A water playground and the Mellitzbach beside the path: keep your dog on the path and out of the play area.
Village lanes at the start and finish.
Carry water even though water points are listed.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
